audit_items.summary: Verify emergency state only triggered by divergent valid proofs

counterexample.preconditions: P1 and P2 are both valid proofs for index I; R1 != R2
attack_sequence: 1. Submit P1 for index I - R1 stored
2. Submit P2 for index I with R2 - triggers emergency
counterexample.expected_outcome: Emergency triggered because valid proofs disagree - this is CORRECT BEHAVIOR indicating ZK system bug

evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: scenario (Counterexample for emergency manipulation: Attacke...)
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guards identified: IRootDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() - ZK proof verification; whenNotPaused modifier - prevents operations during emergency; existingRoot != 0 check - only triggers when root already exists

audit_items.summary: Verify teleport processing requires valid proof data submission

counterexample.preconditions: Attacker calls teleport with proof = bytes('')
counterexample.expected_outcome: Transaction reverts on abi.decode failure

evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: scenario (Attempt teleport with empty proof bytes...)
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guards identified: abi.decode(proof, (uint256[34])) - requires 34 uint256 values; IWithdrawDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof() - ZK proof verification; IWithdrawVerifier.verifyProof() - Groth16 verification for singleTeleport

audit_items.summary: Verify root reference validation checks both proved and global root mappings

counterexample.preconditions: rootHint points to empty slot in both mappings

evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: scenario (Attempt teleport with non-existent root reference...)
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guards identified: require(expectedRoot != 0, ExpectedRootZero(rootHint)); require(expectedRoot == transferRoot, TransferRootMismatch(...)); isGlobal flag determines which root source to validate against

audit_items.summary: Verify recipient hash binds proof to msg.sender

counterexample.preconditions: User U submits proof for recipient hash H derived from their GeneralRecipient; Attacker A monitors mempool
attack_sequence: 1. Attacker extracts proof from user's pending tx
2. Attacker submits same proof with their own GeneralRecipient
counterexample.expected_outcome: Attacker's tx reverts because their gr.hash() != recipient from proof

evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: scenario (Front-running attack: Attacker sees user's telepor...)
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guards identified: gr.hash() cryptographic binding; require(recipient == expectedRecipient, RecipientMismatch(...)); require(gr.chainId == localChainId, InvalidRecipientChainId(...))

audit_items.summary: Verify monotonicity check prevents double-spend

counterexample.preconditions: User has valid proof for value V; totalTeleported[recipient] = 0
attack_sequence: 1. Submit proof, receive V tokens, totalTeleported = V
counterexample.expected_outcome: Second submission reverts: value(V) > totalTeleported(V) is FALSE

evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: scenario (Double-spend attempt via proof replay...)
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guards identified: require(value > currentTotal, NothingToWithdraw(currentTotal, value)); totalTeleported[recipient] += diff - atomic counter update; strict inequality (>) not (>=)

audit_items.summary: Verify withdrawal proof uses Groth16 verification with correct inputs

counterexample.preconditions: Attacker crafts proof with arbitrary pubSignals

counterexample.expected_outcome: Groth16 verification fails, tx reverts with InvalidProof

evidence.phase2_counterexample_attempts: Tried: scenario (Attempt to teleport with forged Groth16 proof...)
evidence.phase3_guard_search: Guards identified: IWithdrawDecider.verifyOpaqueNovaProof(proof_) for Nova proofs; IWithdrawVerifier.verifyProof(pA, pB, pC, pubSignals) for Groth16; Public inputs binding: transferRoot, recipient, totalValue

audit_items.summary: Verify teleport delta calculation is correct
